style: Premium vertical product montage using real Balance screens, deep plum, ivory, gold accents, tactile app-card motion, and a clean logo lockup.
shot_brief: Six real-product beats move through plan, learn, share, track, train, and compete. Each screen arrives as a tactile card with concise copy. The community beat fans three real posts together. The final scene opens to ivory and resolves on the Balance logo, consistency promise, Fitness Gamified tagline, and Join Balance CTA.

timeline.visual: Weekly goals screen with PLAN: A clear focus, every week.
Learning topics screen with LEARN: Know what moves you forward.
Walk, food, and workout posts fan into a community stack with SHARE: Meals. Walks. Workouts. Together.
Nutrition tracker with TRACK: Nutrition without the guesswork.
Movement Studio and Coach's Workouts with TRAIN: Your coach in your corner.
Challenge leaderboard with COMPETE: With friends. Stay motivated.
Ivory Balance logo lockup with consistency promise and Join Balance CTA.
